import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    # skip header
    nl = data.find(b"\n")
    body = data[nl + 1:] if nl >= 0 else b""
    sums = defaultdict(float)
    # Fast path: use integer cents accumulation to avoid float error
    cents = defaultdict(int)
    for line in body.split(b"\n"):
        if not line:
            continue
        i1 = line.find(b",")
        i2 = line.find(b",", i1 + 1)
        cat = line[i1 + 1:i2]
        v = line[i2 + 1:]
        # parse to cents exactly via Decimal only on fallback
        dot = v.find(b".")
        if dot < 0:
            c = int(v) * 100
        else:
            frac = v[dot + 1:]
            ip = v[:dot]
            neg = ip.startswith(b"-")
            ipv = int(ip) if ip not in (b"-", b"") else 0
            f = (frac + b"00")[:2]
            fv = int(f) if f else 0
            c = abs(ipv) * 100 + fv
            if neg:
                c = -c
        cents[cat] += c
    out = []
    for cat in sorted(cents):
        c = cents[cat]
        sign = "-" if c < 0 else ""
        c = abs(c)
        out.append(f"{cat.decode()},{sign}{c // 100}.{c % 100:02d}\n")
    sys.stdout.write("".join(out))

main()

# prints rows/sec * 1e-3 if output matches ref.txt, else 0
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, time, sys
t=time.perf_counter()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"csvsum.py"],stdin=open("data.csv","rb"),capture_output=True)
dt=time.perf_counter()-t
ref=open("ref.txt","rb").read()
if p.returncode!=0 or p.stdout!=ref:
    print(0); sys.exit(0)
print(round(2000000/dt/1000,1))
EOF
